solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique, linked answer split by the grid); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Lovely home wants one evicted

indicators.note: to be evicted is to be thrown out, so one piece is put out of the other

parts.note: wants means desires
one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: A gorgeous house is on the market, but a tenant has to be turfed out first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'evicted' removes I from DESIRES. DES RES is estate-agent shorthand for a desirable residence.
explanation.definitionFit: Estate-agent slang for a desirable residence, an attractive property to live in.

clue.text: The thing fixed first

indicators.note: the word for fixed is told to come first, ahead of the other piece

parts.note: fixed means definite, settled
a thing is an article, an object

explanation.surface: A setter states that one particular item was mended before anything else.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is just the word 'The', which grammar books call by this name.
explanation.definitionFit: In grammar the word 'the' is classed as this, as against the indefinite a or an.

clue.text: Girl departs, carrying new black vase with light damage

indicators.note: a person carrying something holds it, so one piece holds the others

parts.note: Sue is a girl's name
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
an urn is a vase
D is the abbreviation for departs, as on timetables

explanation.surface: A girl leaves with a vase, and the vase is damaged by light.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with light damage' reads like part of the vase story, but it is the definition: harmed by sunlight.
explanation.definitionFit: Skin harmed by too much exposure to sunshine is described this way.

clue.text: Prophet, first in Israel, heals mysteriously outside

indicators.note: outside means the rearranged letters sit around the other piece
something done mysteriously is jumbled beyond understanding, so the letters are rearranged
first in means take the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A prophet, the foremost in Israel, cures people in a mysterious way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mysteriously' rearranges HEALS to ELSHA, and 'outside' places it round I, the first letter of Israel.
explanation.definitionFit: Elijah's successor, an Old Testament prophet famed for healing miracles.

clue.text: God shelters unknown ship that goes after Zero the Hero

indicators.note: goes after places the following construction behind the letter for zero

parts.note: zero looks like the letter O

indicators.note: a shelter encloses, so the word for god holds the other pieces

parts.note: Deus is Latin for god
Y is an algebraic unknown
SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: A deity protects a mystery vessel that is pursuing a ridiculous character called Zero the Hero.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Zero the Hero' sounds like a cartoon character; Zero gives O and 'Hero' alone defines the hero of Homer's Odyssey.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek king of Ithaca is the hero of Homer's epic about his voyage home from Troy.

clue.text: Pathologist's indication with gas lit

indicators.note: lit is slang for drunk, and drunk letters reel into a new order

explanation.surface: A pathologist's signal is made with a burning gas jet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lit' rearranges INDICATION and GAS together. The 's stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A pathologist studies disease and identifies it, which is the work of a specialist in diagnosis.

clue.text: Son the one she loves in general

parts.note: the one she loves is her man

explanation.surface: A son is the person his mother adores, generally speaking.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in general' reads as 'usually' but 'general' is the definition: the American Civil War general William Sherman.
explanation.definitionFit: William Tecumseh Sherman was a Union general in the American Civil War.

clue.text: Orient harbours UK ships having extradited a German artist

indicators.note: a harbour holds ships, so the word for orient holds the other piece
extradited means sent out of the country, so the letter is removed

parts.note: the Orient is the East
RN is the Royal Navy, the UK's ships

explanation.surface: The Far East shelters British vessels, having handed a German painter over to the authorities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having extradited' leaves EST once A goes; the Royal Navy then sits inside. Max Ernst was a Surrealist painter.
explanation.definitionFit: Max Ernst was a German-born painter of the Dada and Surrealist movements.

clue.text: Buddhist community praised in verse first couple from Halaesa

parts.note: to praise in verse is to sing of, past tense sang

indicators.note: first couple from means take the opening two letters of the next word

explanation.surface: A Buddhist group was celebrated in poetry, the first pair coming from the Sicilian town of Halaesa.
explanation.walkthrough: Halaesa was an ancient city in Sicily; only its first two letters HA are needed.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sangha is the Buddhist order of monks and nuns, one of the Three Jewels.

clue.text: Following peacekeepers, soldier comes to kingdom

parts.note: UN peacekeepers belong to the United Nations
a GI is an American soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier arrives in a realm behind a peacekeeping force.
explanation.walkthrough: Biologists classify living things into kingdoms, and mushrooms and moulds form one of their own.
explanation.definitionFit: Biological classification puts mushrooms, yeasts and moulds in a separate taxonomic kingdom.

clue.text: Greek leader soon to host contest millions follow

indicators.note: a host has guests inside, so the word for soon holds the other pieces

parts.note: anon is an old word for soon

indicators.note: follow says the letter for millions comes after the contest

parts.note: a game is a contest

explanation.surface: A Greek commander will shortly stage a match watched by millions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'soon' is the old-fashioned anon, as in 'see you anon'.
explanation.definitionFit: The king of Mycenae commanded the Greek forces at the siege of Troy.

clue.text: Ulysses remake represented modern-day exiles

indicators.note: represented means presented again in another form, so the letters are reordered

explanation.surface: A new version of Joyce's novel portrayed people driven from home today.
explanation.walkthrough: 'represented' rearranges ULYSSES and REMAKE together.
explanation.definitionFit: People fleeing danger who request refuge in another country are today's displaced exiles.

clue.text: Anything whatever in Big Apple is mildly indecent

indicators.note: in places the word for anything inside the letters for the city

parts.note: the Big Apple is New York, NY
aught means anything whatever

explanation.surface: Anything goes in New York, which is a little risqué.
explanation.walkthrough: Aught is an old word for anything at all, as in 'for aught I know'.
explanation.definitionFit: Naughty in the sense of saucy or risqué, slightly improper.

clue.text: As Hector to Achilles where bout cancelled?

definitions.meaning: Hector could not equal Achilles, who killed him at Troy
a bout called off leaves no contest at all

explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means an unequal contestant, and taken literally it means a fight that does not take place.

clue.text: Time, lunchtime perhaps, sets mood

parts.note: lunchtime is perhaps one o'clock

explanation.surface: The midday hour determines the atmosphere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' marks lunchtime as an example of the hour of one o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: The tone of a place or a piece of writing is its general atmosphere or feeling.

clue.text: Meets with an accident?

parts.note: to meet someone by accident is to encounter them by chance, but a crash also strikes something

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both encountering someone by chance and colliding with something.

clue.text: Manage without Conservative helping process

indicators.note: without means the letter for Conservative is left out

parts.note: to manage is to cope
a helping is a ration, a portion

explanation.surface: Getting by without a Tory's assistance is a process.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Manage' wants to be OPERATE or RUN, but it is COPE; 'without' drops C to leave OPE.
explanation.definitionFit: An operation is a series of actions carried out to achieve something, a working procedure.

clue.text: One watches from Bastille the 9s, keeping temperature raised

indicators.note: in a down clue raised means the letters are read upwards, bottom to top

parts.note: le is French for the, the Bastille being in Paris

indicators.note: keeping means holding inside, so the word for nines holds the letter for temperature

parts.note: 9s is nines, the figure written out

explanation.surface: A guard on the Bastille's walls watches the fungi as the temperature goes up.
explanation.walkthrough: '9s' seems to send you to the answer at 9 across, but it is just the figure spelt out. 'keeping' makes NINTES; 'raised' then turns the whole run upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A sentinel is a sentry, someone posted to keep guard and watch.

clue.text: Servant in violent incident at home

definitions.meaning: a household servant, such as a maid or cleaner
informal word for a violent row in a household

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a household servant and, informally, a violent quarrel inside a household.

clue.text: Bacterium found in rodents where Sting resides?

indicators.note: found in means the second piece is located inside the first

parts.note: mice are rodents
to sting is to rob or swindle

explanation.surface: A germ is discovered among the mice where the singer Sting lives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sting' looks like the singer but is a verb meaning to cheat or swindle.
explanation.definitionFit: A microbe is a microorganism, and bacteria are a common kind.

clue.text: Present from Andromache returned

indicators.note: from means the letters are taken out of the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: A gift from Hector's wife Andromache was sent back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' looks like a reversal indicator, but the letters run forwards across Andromache and returned.
explanation.definitionFit: To be present is to be in this place, at hand.

clue.text: Catholic washing in very hot stream to cover bodily stench

indicators.note: in a down clue the covering piece sits on top, so it comes first

parts.note: lava is a stream of molten rock
BO is body odour

explanation.surface: A Catholic bathes in a scalding river to mask an unpleasant body smell.
explanation.walkthrough: A lavabo is the ritual washing of the priest's hands at Mass, and also the basin used for it.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Catholic Mass the priest's ritual hand-washing is known by this Latin name.

clue.text: Donkey taken to northern water shows promise

indicators.note: taken to means joined onto the following piece

parts.note: an ass is a donkey
the Ure is a river in North Yorkshire, in northern England

explanation.surface: A donkey led to a river in the north shows potential.
explanation.walkthrough: The Ure is a river in Yorkshire in the north of England.
explanation.definitionFit: To assure someone is to pledge or guarantee something to them.

clue.text: See 1 down
Mountain lake appreciated by old male coming about

indicators.note: by means placed beside the next piece

parts.note: ta is a British way of saying thanks

indicators.note: coming about means going around, so the word for male surrounds the letter for old

parts.note: he is a male pronoun

explanation.surface: A mountain lake is admired by an elderly man returning.
explanation.walkthrough: TA is British slang for thank you. 'coming about' wraps the pronoun round O to give HOE.
explanation.definitionFit: Lake Tahoe is a large lake high in the Sierra Nevada, on the California-Nevada border.

clue.text: Coffee time?

definitions.meaning: powdered coffee made by adding hot water
a moment, a very short time

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a quick soluble coffee and a single moment of time.

clue.text: Museum has modified procedure with bank

indicators.note: modified means changed, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: MO is modus operandi, a way of working
to bank is to lean, as an aircraft tilts

explanation.surface: A museum has altered its method of dealing with a bank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'modified' rearranges HAS into ASH.
explanation.definitionFit: The Ashmolean in Oxford is Britain's oldest public museum.

clue.text: Confederacy, or those opposed to it?

definitions.meaning: a league or alliance of states
in the American Civil War the northern states fought the southern Confederacy

explanation.definitionFit: A union is an alliance, and it was also the name of the northern side opposing the Confederacy.

clue.text: Cooked on both sides, done with a piece of cake

parts.note: done means over, finished
a piece of cake means easy

explanation.surface: A thing is browned on both sides, finished with a slice of cake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a piece of cake' looks like food in a cooking surface but means simple.
explanation.definitionFit: A fried egg turned and cooked briefly on both sides is ordered this way in American diners.

clue.text: Boys in rhyme — one back in doghouse

parts.note: Ken and Len are boys' names that rhyme

indicators.note: one back means one of the pair is written backwards

parts.note: Ken and Len are boys' names that rhyme

explanation.surface: Boys from a nursery rhyme end up in the doghouse, one of them at the rear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one back' turns the second name round to NEL.
explanation.definitionFit: A kennel is a shelter for a dog, a doghouse.
